set.body:
Extend the existing admission workflow with a bounded transfer reader. Accept verified packages under independent local authority.

Acceptance criteria

1. Validate expected inventory, paths, sizes, digests and version before publishing a release. A refusal or interrupted attempt cannot leave a visible partial release.
2. Preserve exact files and directories and the authorized source reference. Handle the source release and local release as separate identities. Importing the same transfer with the same intent is retry-safe.
3. Record a receiving custodian and require explicit local access decisions. Source grants, principals and project structure do not become local rights.
4. The receiver explains tamper, unsupported-version and issuer-assurance outcomes. Its catalogue can resolve the allowed origin without requiring a live source.

Verification

Reference and PostgreSQL admission tests include byte changes, empty directories, duplicate retry and a restricted view. Compare against the independent verifier.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: INT03: Verify a transfer and admit it under the receiving custodian
